title: 2025 budget enacted and firefighter agreement approved
subtitle: Bridge weight limits, short term rental licensing, Jefferson Elora development charge deferral, interim tax levy and temporary borrowing also decided.
overview: Council enacted the 2025 budget by by-law, with the portion tied to the Fergus BIA handled separately because Councillor Jefferson declared a conflict of interest and left the room. Council also passed the 2025 interim tax levy and temporary borrowing by-laws, which set how taxes are installed and how the Township manages cash early in the year.

After closed session, Council approved a tentative agreement with the Elora and Fergus Volunteer Firefighters Associations and a Firefighter Market Review Study to be completed in 2025 {{vote:m3}}. Council also adopted weight limits for certain bridges, which staff said the OPP would help enforce, and discussion touched on effects on farmers and emergency response times.

Staff were directed to prepare a draft short term rental licensing by-law and implementation plan for advisory committee review. Council authorized a development charge deferral agreement with Jefferson Elora Corporation, which plans a building expansion. Consent items included heritage designation notices for three properties and a grant application for electric fleet funding. The Mayor also presented a $24,000 cheque from a golf tournament to youth wellness organization the Grove Hubs.

decisions.detail: Council authorized the Mayor and Clerk to execute the by-law enacting the 2025 budget {{vote:m10}}.
Council authorized execution of the budget by-law excluding matters related to the Fergus BIA, on which Councillor Jefferson did not participate {{vote:m11}}.
Council approved the tentative agreement with the Elora and Fergus Volunteer Firefighters Associations and a Firefighter Market Review Study to be completed in 2025.
Council adopted a by-law restricting the weight of vehicles crossing certain Township bridges, per Report IS2024-36.
Council received the update and directed staff to bring a draft licensing by-law and implementation plan to the Economic Prosperity & Growth Advisory Committee before Council considers it.
Council authorized a Development Charge Deferral Payment Agreement with Jefferson Elora Corporation.
Council passed a by-law providing for the 2025 interim tax levy and payment of taxes by installments.
Council passed a by-law establishing temporary borrowing for 2025.
